name: Talk of the Town
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.

The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
narrative.objectives: Visit Nixxrax Fillamug in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn.
